Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files with .somnia extension using AES algorithm (initially 3DES)
Infects systems via fake sites mimicking 'Advanced IP Scanner' to trick employees into downloading installer
Installer drops Vidar stealer to steal Telegram session data
Uses stolen Telegram account to steal VPN connection data (authentication and certificates)
Uses VPN credentials without two-factor authentication to access corporate networks
Deploys Cobalt Strike beacon, exfiltrates data, uses Netscan, Rclone, Anydesk, and Ngrok for surveillance and remote access
Does not request ransom, acts as data wiper to disrupt operations
Discoverer: Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA)
Attack Vector: Fake websites mimicking legitimate software to deliver installer
Compromise of Telegram accounts to steal VPN credentials
Unauthorized VPN access to corporate networks
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Cobalt Strike, Netscan, Rclone, Anydesk, Ngrok tools
